title: Extra Life 2026 group bonuses start November 10
body:
**Extra Life Game Week** is underway (November 7–15, 2026), and EverQuest II's group fundraising bonuses are about to turn on. Darkpaw is raising for Rady Children's Hospital – San Diego; Team Darkpaw's goal is **$115,000**, with Daybreak kicking in $5,000.

**Schedule (Pacific / Alaska):**
- **Group donation tally:** November 9, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. PT (**9:00 a.m. AKST**). Later donations still count for individual rewards.
- **Group bonuses on:** November 10, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. PT (**7:00 a.m. AKST**), based on the November 9 total.
- **Group bonuses off:** November 17, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. PT (**6:00 a.m. AKST**).
- **Individual incentives** stay available through December 31, 2026 at 11:45 p.m. PT.

**Live and TLE servers — group milestones** (selected tiers):
- $15,000 = 10% Bonus Experience and 1% Increased Rare Drop Chance
- $25,000 = 45% Bonus Experience and 6% Increased Rare Drop Chance
- $30,000 = 75% Bonus Experience, 6% Increased Rare Drop Chance, and Double Currency Rewards
- $35,000 = 100% Bonus Experience, 10% Increased Rare Drop Chance, Double Currency Rewards, and Double loot drops in current expansions
- $50,000 = 175% Bonus Experience, 25% Increased Rare Drop Chance, Double Currency, Double loot in current expansions, and 25% Bonus Status Gains
- $115,000 (goal) = 275% Bonus Experience, 50% Increased Rare Drop Chance, Double Currency, Double loot in current expansions, and 85% Bonus Status Gains

Full Live/TLE tiers run from $15,000 through $115,000 on the official page.

**Origins servers only — group milestones** are Adventure and Tradeskill Experience bonuses only (2% at $15,000, scaling to 30% at $115,000). Origins do **not** get the Live/TLE rare-drop, currency, loot, or status group bonuses.

**Individual donor rewards** (stack; higher tiers include lower ones): $5 The Charitable; $10 the Unsparing + Minor Potion of Allied Advancement; $25 True Samaritan + Greater Potion; $50 the Selfless + mercenary Elgra Frop; $100 Paradigm + Topsie familiar. Fundraiser rewards at $250 / $500 / $1,000 include Vakita the Fair and Wings of the Paradigm.

How-to and donate links are in Darkpaw's Extra Life guide and the incentives post.

title: Heroes' Festival 2026 is live through November 18
body:
**Heroes' Festival** started the morning of **November 5, 2026** and runs through **November 18, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. PT**, celebrating 22 years of EverQuest II.

**Wuoshi (TLE):** the event is active, with these exceptions because of expansion availability: **Mischeva's Clothworks**, **Thumore's quest line**, and **One Afterlife to Live** are not available. Heroes' Festival merchant prices are adjusted for TLE because Clothworks is missing. Players get in-game mail announcing the TLE event.

**Other special-rules servers:** Kael Drakkel is active except **a Dream Adventure** and **One Afterlife to Live**. Varsoon has the full event.

**Live servers highlights:** dragons attack the spires in Thundering Steppes, Everfrost, Loping Plains, and Nektulos Forest; defend them and build faction with the Quellithulian Portal Scholars in Antonica and The Commonlands. Eight new house items (Token of Heroism) and ten new equipment items (Mischeva's Tribute) are on the Heroes' Festival New Additions merchants in Freeport and Qeynos Capitol District. Returning dragon items are on Ziyuh Farijinyi; holiday merchants and recipes return in Freeport and Qeynos.

See the official post for achievements, collections, Overseer quests, and the full quest list. Event pages on this site: [[Heroes' Festival Timeline]].

title: Descent to Val'Zyroth beta and pre-orders are open
body:
The **Descent to Val'Zyroth** beta opened on **October 13, 2026**, the same day pre-orders went live. Beta runs until the expansion is ready to ship.

- **How to get in**: every pre-order edition (Standard, Collector's, Premium and Family & Friends) includes beta access and the **Pilbippi Mudpuppy** pet. If you can't see the Beta forums after buying, log out of the forums and back in.
- **Personas**: level any class on a single character.
- **New and improved Untold Heroic dungeons.**
- **A new Epic mount** that you unlock through a scavenger hunt.
- **New Adventure, Tradeskill and Signature quests**, plus new solo, heroic and raid content in Val'Zyroth Ness, the dark elves' Duchy of the Dead, Keramos Caverns and the mines of Khor Boldir.
- **New Collections.**
- **Beta rewards** are claimable on live after launch. Among them: the Jumble Jelly pack pony appearance for the Tradeskill quests, the Moderate Mudderite familiar for the Signature quests, and a flying unlock in Val'Zyroth Ness for one character for finishing all beta quests. The full list is in the announcement.

The launch date hasn't been announced yet. No level cap increase (stays at 135). The developer livestream is on November 18, 2026. See [[Beta Testing Expansions]] for tips on copying your characters to beta.

title: Descent to Val'Zyroth announced, and Frostfell gets Event Gifting
body:
**Descent to Val'Zyroth** is EverQuest II's 2026 expansion, the 23rd, announced in the September 2026 Producer's Letter. Queen Cristanos is finally making her move: you plunge through the tunnels of Subtunaria into the glowing, magic-soaked reaches of the Underfoot, infiltrate the Teir'Dal (dark elf) city of Neriondalon, fight alongside the Tontu molemen and breach Brell Serilis' planar workshops.

- **Personas**: a new feature that lets your hero level an entirely new class from scratch on the same character. Darkpaw explains it in the official [Persona Guide](https://www.everquest2.com/guides/eq2-persona-guide).
- **Beta and pre-orders** open October 13, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. PT.
- **Developer livestream**: November 18, 2026.
- **Launch date**: not announced yet.

The prelude event [[Paths of Sedition]], which lays the groundwork for the expansion, started October 6.

**Frostfell: Event Gifting.** This year's Frostfell brings a new feature called Event Gifting. Using a registry system, you'll be able to give gifts to other players and receive gifts from them. It centers on specific house items such as the Frostfell Gift Giving Sack and the Frostfell Gift Getting Stocking. Darkpaw will post a full guide closer to launch.
